Get into the fun and musical madness of the 90s with O Mummy Mummy from the superhit film Deewana Mastana (1997)! Featuring Govinda and Juhi Chawla, this entertaining number brings back the unmistakable charm of 90s Bollywood. Sung by the ever-popular Udit Narayan, this lively track is packed with nostalgia and the playful energy that made 90s Hindi film music so memorable.
